statusMeaning.PASS: Verified at this commit by a check that ran in the sandbox, named in the evidence. It still needs an owner's name and a re-run on the intended release before sign-off.
statusMeaning.FAIL: The control is missing or known not to meet the check; the next step says how to fix it or what to switch off.
statusMeaning.UNVERIFIED: No adequate evidence yet: implemented but not run here, or it depends on the deployed environment, an account setting, a provider or a person.
statusMeaning.N/A: The capability or risk is absent from this release, with the reason; reopen if that changes.

checks.evidence: New: the one cookie is "keep me signed in" (__Secure-niveloft-session over HTTPS): HttpOnly, Secure, Path=/api/auth, Max-Age to its session's end; SameSite=None and Partitioned by default over HTTPS (the API usually sits on another site than the app), Lax over plain HTTP, or set with SESSION_COOKIE_SAMESITE. checks.evidence: New: sign-in tokens live only in the tab (sessionStorage), a day at most, each checked against its server session on every request. "Keep me signed in" is an HttpOnly cookie that can only get a new token for its own session (POST /api/auth/refresh: the app's origin only, rate-limited); the database keeps only the SHA-256 of its 256-bit secret; tokens an earlier release left in localStorage are moved into the tab. The decision and the remaining XSS exposure are documented in docs/launch/README.md. [cookie], [cross-site], [test-api] (keptSignIn.test.ts, launch.test.ts), [browser] launch controls.
checks.risk: A script injected into the page could still use or read the open tab's token (a day at most, ended by signing out) and renew it while it runs; it can't read the cookie. The Content-Security-Policy allows scripts from this site only.
checks.next: Run ./mvnw verify (LaunchControlsTest.keptSignIns).
